name: id
description: event (list interval) index, sorted by start time

name: start_time, end_time
description: wave-burst interval containing the TDS (not the TDS itself; see tds_start/tds_end), floored to 1 s

name: duration
description: end − start (unfloored)

name: radius
description: geocentric distance, burst mean

name: gsm_x, gsm_y, gsm_z
description: position GSM, burst mean

name: mlt, mlat
description: MLT and magnetic latitude: SM, mean of burst start and end

name: lang_max_Ez, lang_rms_Ew
description: Lang's max |E∥| (100–3000 Hz, unrecorded sub-window) and FBK rms E (start ±30 s; whole-day max on many 2016–2022 days); report.typ, Lang's list section

name: lang_Bx, lang_By, lang_Bz
description: Lang's B GSM: mean fgs over start ±30 s

name: B_x, B_y, B_z, B_t
description: FGM fgl GSM B, component medians over the interval (fgs ±1.5 s if no fgl); B_t = |B|

name: Bbg_x, Bbg_y, Bbg_z, Bbg_t
description: background B GSM: fgs medians over tc ±5 min

name: theta_B, theta_Bbg
description: elevation atan(Bz/√(Bx²+By²)) of interval / background B

name: Bx_over_Bt
description: |Bx|/|B|: ~1 in lobe/PSBL, ~0 at the neutral sheet

name: dBz_1min
description: median Bz in [tc, tc+1 min] − [tc−1 min, tc]; dipolarization indicator

name: Ni, Ti, Ti_par, Ti_perp
description: ion density, average/parallel/perpendicular temperature: mean of spin samples within the interval ±1.5 s; GMOM ESA+SST burst (ptibb), else reduced (ptirf)

name: Vi_x, Vi_y, Vi_z, Vi_t
description: ion bulk velocity GSM and |V|, same samples

name: V_par_5min, V_perp_5min
description: V·b̂ and |V⊥|, b̂ from the ±5-min background B (steady magnetosphere; window-dependent if bg_rot > 30°)

name: Vperp_5min_x, Vperp_5min_y, Vperp_5min_z
description: V⊥ GSM, same b̂

name: V_par_30s, V_perp_30s
description: same with b̂ from fgs medians over tc ±30 s (sheath, where the field rotates within a minute)

name: bg_rot
description: angle between fgs medians over [tc−5 min, tc] and [tc, tc+5 min]; large ⇒ background window straddles a boundary

name: Vx_peak_5min
description: ion Vx (reduced mode) with largest |Vx| within tc ±5 min, 3-spin running median (flow-burst indicator)

name: Ne, Te, Te_par, Te_perp
description: electron moments, same samples; GMOM burst (ptebb), else reduced (pterf)

name: beta_i, beta_e, beta
description: 2μ0 n T / B² for ions, electrons, total

name: debye_m
description: electron Debye length √(ε0 Te / n_e e²)

name: fpe_fce
description: f_pe/f_ce

name: VA_kms
description: Alfvén speed (protons)

name: Te_Ti, Ti_aniso, Te_aniso
description: Te/Ti, Ti⊥/Ti∥, Te⊥/Te∥ (Te_aniso meaningful only when mom_burst & 2)

name: flag_ion, flag_ele
description: OR of GMOM quality flags over the moment samples (-1: no data)

name: mom_burst
description: moment source bits: 1 = ion burst, 2 = electron burst; else reduced mode

name: mom_mask
description: masked-moment bits: 1 = ion, 2 = electron n < 1e-3 cm⁻³ (SST-only sums, all moments NaN); 4 = ion V ≈ 0 and T⊥ ≡ T∥ (no angular information; V, T∥, T⊥ NaN)

name: n_fgm, n_fgm_bg, n_ion, n_ele
description: sample counts: FGM interval, FGM background, ion and electron moments

name: BX_GSE, BY_GSM, BZ_GSM
description: OMNI 1-min IMF (bow-shock-nose time), mean of the minutes overlapping the interval

name: BZ_GSM_1h
description: IMF Bz mean over the hour before the interval

name: flow_speed, proton_density, Pressure
description: solar wind speed, density, dynamic pressure, same minutes

name: AE_INDEX, AL_INDEX, SYM_H
description: AE, AL, SYM-H, same minutes

name: AL_min_1h, AE_max_1h
description: min AL, max AE in the hour before the interval

name: Kp
description: Kp (OMNI2 hourly) at start_time

name: r_over_rmp
description: r / Shue98 magnetopause radius at the same angle

name: region
description: heuristic region: sheath/SW, dayside/inner (X>−5), PS, PSBL, lobe

name: efw_window
description: window of all efw_* stats: tds = detector TDS window (tds_start–tds_end), list = Lang's [start, end + 1 s] where no TDS was detected

name: efw_n, efw_ac
description: # efw waveform samples in the window (8192 or 16384 S/s), fraction AC-coupled

name: efw_t_Ez, efw_Ez, efw_Eperp_Ez, efw_ratio_Ez, efw_phi_Ez
description: at max |Ez| (DSL spin axis; own L1 calibration, 100–3000 Hz band-pass, boom-shadow phases masked): time, signed Ez, in-band |E⊥B|, |Ez|/|E⊥|, spin phase

name: efw_t_Epar, efw_Epar, efw_Eperp_Epar, efw_ratio_Epar, efw_phi_Epar
description: same at max |E∥|, E∥ = E·b̂ with b̂ the window-median B

name: efw_rms_Ez, efw_rms_Exy
description: in-band rms Ez and spin-plane |E| over the window

name: efw_clip
description: fraction of samples with a raw channel at the ADC rail (±32767, or −32768 = fill); > 0 ⇒ maxima are lower bounds (spin-plane AC saturates near 70 mV/m)

name: Epar_norm, Ez_norm
description: e|E∥|λ_D/T_e (≈ eφ/T_e for a Debye-scale structure), same with |Ez|

name: det_status
description: automatic detector (detect/report.typ) on the bursts overlapping [start, end + 1 s]: tds (the event owns TDS pulses, see tds_tha_pulses), no_tds, no_b (no b̂, never TDS), no_burst (none ≥ 4096 samples)

name: tds_start, tds_end
description: first to last of the event's TDS pulses ± 10 ms: the TDS window, which Lang's list does not record

name: tds_n_trains, tds_n_pulses, tds_class
description: number of TDS trains holding the event's TDS pulses, and of those pulses; class (bipolar/unipolar/mixed) of the train holding most of them

name: tds_peak, tds_Epar_ratio, tds_clip
description: largest of the event's TDS pulses (signed, E∥ or Ez, 150 Hz high-pass) and its in-band |E∥|/|E⊥|; max rail-sample fraction near its trains (> 0 ⇒ lower bound)
